## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Trace actual fixed bugs and critical paths to real tests and run evidence. A test that has not been observed failing against the unfixed defect does not establish regression sensitivity; report that gap. Preserve risk-based scope, user decisions and quarantine boundaries.
